summary: This macro filters claims data to the 'Care Navigation' program and then summarizes savings and claim counts by program. It scores 1 out of 10, the lowest difficulty band, because both tools used are simple, direct-translation operations. There are no gotchas or structural complications noted in the facts.

key_components.description: Filter [3] keeps only rows where program equals 'Care Navigation'.
Summarize [6] groups the filtered data by program, summing savings and counting claim_id.

risks.title: Unlabeled upstream/downstream tools
risks.detail: The data flow shows tools 2, 4, 5, and 7 feeding into or out of the filter and summarize steps, but the facts don't describe what these tools do. This can't be assessed from the workflow file as given.

next_steps: Confirm what tools 2, 4, 5, and 7 do, since they are not detailed in the extracted facts but are part of the data flow.
